title: Bishop warns COP31 draft could prolong fossil fuel dependence

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Catholic bishop from Negros has called on world leaders to renew their commitment to moving away from fossil fuels after the latest draft agreement at the United Nations climate conference dropped references to the transition, warning that poor communities could bear the cost of continued dependence on coal, oil and gas.
